result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban side street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The environment is characterized by a short crossing distance and low-speed geometry, though sightlines are restricted by the building corner.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The building sits directly on the corner, creating a visual obstruction for both pedestrians and drivers entering the narrow street.

hazards.name: Missing Tactile Warnings
hazards.description: The curb ramp lacks truncated domes, which are necessary for pedestrians with visual impairments to identify the transition to the roadway.

interventions.title: Detectable Warning Surfaces
interventions.description: Install truncated domes on the curb ramp to meet accessibility standards and improve safety for visually impaired pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow vehicle speeds and increase the visibility of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add signage to warn drivers of the pedestrian crossing, especially given the limited sightlines around the building corner.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, paved sidewalks and curb ramps within a dense commercial district. However, safety is compromised by a large parking garage entrance that creates a conflict point across the sidewalk and faded crosswalk markings at the intersection.

hazards.name: Garage Conflict Point
hazards.description: A large parking garage entrance/exit on the left requires vehicles to cross the pedestrian sidewalk, creating potential for collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, mid-ground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk in the foreground is significantly worn and faded, reducing its visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the existing crosswalk with a high-visibility continental pattern to improve driver compliance and pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Garage Exit Warning System
interventions.description: Install audible or visual warning signals at the garage exit to alert pedestrians when a vehicle is emerging.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow, pedestrian-oriented urban street with wide sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. The environment features curb ramps with tactile paving and decorative street lighting, though it lacks explicit pedestrian signals or signage.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra crossing paint is worn, which may reduce its visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the zebra markings with high-visibility, durable thermoplastic paint to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to act as a speed table and reinforce the pedestrian priority in this narrow corridor.

result.summary: A narrow urban canyon with a wide, clear sidewalk on the left and large commercial vehicles parked on the right. The street features decorative lighting and a bicycle stencil, but lacks formal crossing infrastructure or traffic control devices.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Trucks
hazards.description: Large delivery trucks parked along the narrow roadway significantly block sightlines between pedestrians and potential moving traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points and alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
